shared_invariants.rule: Map-first guest browsing; optional preferences/ID must not block initial map.
Account, Person, Age, credential/VP, Payment KYC and service entitlement remain separate. Fixture/local declarations never become real provider verification.
One topmost modal owns focus, inert background, close and keyboard; closing restores exact source focus or safe same-context fallback.
Return token binds action, subject and exact place/context. No private draft, proof, wallet or payment authority in URL; consume once and reject stale/mismatched intent.
Pre-submit cancel does not mutate. Closing after submission is not cancellation or refund: pending/unknown/held amounts must remain identifiable and recheckable.
Funding credit only after destination confirmation; apply once. Funding is not purchase consent, age/person proof, benefit eligibility or visit proof.
Authorize/hold, capture, settlement and partial/full refund remain separate. Unknown is neither paid nor failed; retries target same operation.
Table social plan is not merchant reservation. Listing/research/photo does not imply partner services or verified live availability.
Heat replay, local contribution and actual verified activity are distinct. Payment/photo/ID is not a real visit.
Locale, theme and After 19 are independent dimensions. Preserve reduced-motion, image/tile failure, keyboard, small-height and storage failure branches.
Reload persistence is feature-specific; sharing a state provider is not proof that money/order/identity sessions survive reload.
